friendly: Oh! You must be the new farmer. Welcome to the valley.
It's always nice to see someone breathing new life into that old farm.
You picked a beautiful place to settle down.
I was wondering when we'd finally meet. Welcome!
The town isn't very big, so I'm sure we'll see each other again.
Moving is exhausting. I hope you've had a chance to catch your breath.
A new neighbor is always something to celebrate.
I hope the valley treats you kindly.
Welcome! Around here, everyone ends up knowing everyone.
The old farmhouse has good bones. I bet it'll feel cozy before long.
The valley always feels a little brighter when someone new arrives.
reserved: You're the new farmer, I assume.
I heard someone bought the old farm.
Best of luck getting that place back into shape.
The valley grows on people... eventually.
I don't usually introduce myself, but welcome.
It'll be interesting to see what becomes of that farm.
The previous owner left quite a mess.
You're a long way from wherever you came from.
_generic.gift_love: Oh! %item? This is wonderful. Thank you!
_generic.gift_hate: Why would you give me this?

intro: You're the new farmer? Awesome! You seem like someone who appreciates handmade things.
moving_in: I almost made you a welcome quilt... then I realized I don't know your favorite colors.
Moving means unpacking boxes. My least favorite kind of crafting.
spring: Have you walked around much? I love finding stumps covered in mushrooms!
any: The best gifts are the ones that take time to make.
Some colors just belong together. You don't realize it until you put them side by side.
Finishing a project feels nice... but I also love getting started on the next one.
janis.gift_love: Oh, %item! I already know exactly what I'm going to make with this.
janis.gift_like: %item? Thank you! Handmade or homegrown, it's the thought that counts.

intro: Have you started growing anything yet? Just throw some seeds in the ground!
moving_in: Welcome! Watch where you step around the ponds. The frogs were here first.
If you happen to see any unusual reptiles, I'd love to hear about it.
The valley has an incredible variety of amphibians. It's one of the reasons I stayed.
The farm borders some wonderful habitat. Lucky you.
Don't worry if a snake wanders through your fields. It's probably just passing by.
You're bound to discover interesting wildlife while clearing your land.
Welcome. I hope you don't mind sharing the valley with its smaller residents.
spring: Some people would start growing their peppers from seed now, but I brought my peppers inside for winter so they're ready to go.
Have you heard any wood frogs yet? They usually start chirping right around now.
any: Reptiles have terrible public relations.
Lizards can sit perfectly still for so long. I wish I had that kind of patience.
I spotted a little skink sunning herself earlier on the Warm Rock. I'm glad people share with the smaller residents.
People think snakes are scary. Most of them just want to be left alone. Sometimes I can't help but pick 'em up for a little snuggle though.
pete.gift_love: %item! Oh, this is going straight into tonight's dinner. Thank you.
pete.gift_dislike: Huh. %item. I'll... find a use for it.

intro: Welcome newcomer! If you hear someone talking to themselves around town... I'm probably just working out dialogue.
moving_in: I was outlining a chapter when I heard someone moving in. Hello!
spring: Spring. New chapters, new drafts. Same desk.
any: Every draft teaches you something. Usually humility.
Some days the words flow. Other days I reorganize my desk and pretend that counts as progress.
I'm heading to a convention next month. It's nice meeting people who get excited about fictional worlds.
Someone once brought me fan art. I don't think I'll ever forget that.
Nothing motivates you to finish a book quite like meeting excited fans at a con.
Panels are just controlled chaos with microphones.

intro: Nice to meet you! I'm usually at home so I'm pretty easy to find for a chat.
spring: It looks nice outside. Unfortunately, I'm already committed to this chair.
any: My chair has molded itself perfectly to me. I think we've become one.
I was going to clean today... then I remembered I had a perfectly good game waiting.
I don't mind staying home. There's always something to do.
Sleep schedules are more of a suggestion than a rule.
I should probably enjoy the sunshine while it's here. :/
It's too nice to stay inside... which is inconvenient.
Maybe I'll sit on the porch today. That counts as going out.
rain: I almost went outside today... then I heard the rain.
Perfect. No expectations to leave the house.
friendly: It's nice having someone who doesn't expect me to be out doing something all the time.
I don't usually invite people over, but I like it when you stop by.

intro: Everything in here's washed and everything in here's fair and nothing in here gets wasted. That's the shop. That's the whole shop. Welcome to it.
any: Seeds are by the season. Don't ask me for summer seeds in spring, I won't have them and I won't pretend to.
Bring me what you grow. I'll pay what it's worth. Not a coin more, not a coin less.
Washed, weighed, fair. Say it with me.
rain: Rain's good for the crops and bad for the floor. Wipe your feet.

intro: A new face. I'll remember it the rest of my life... as well as how you treat my family.
moving_in: Don't look so surprised. I'm the merchant. The humans got used to it years ago.
A fresh face. Fresh opportunities. Welcome.
You have interesting eyes. They suggest you'll find interesting things.
Every traveler leaves something behind. Every newcomer brings something unexpected.
If you find anything shiny, I'll know before you do.
any: Never underestimate a bird with a good memory.
See anything you like? If not... perhaps you brought something I like.
You'd be amazed what people leave behind when they're in a hurry.
That ring catches the light nicely...
Did you mean to leave that unattended?
rain: Wet feathers are bad for business.
Rain keeps customers indoors. Fortunately, I can wait.
friendly: Most people only see 'a raven.' You actually stop to talk.
You're one of my favorite regulars. Don't make me regret saying that.
If I find something with your name on it... I'll set it aside.

intro: Moving is exhausting - here, I saved you a loaf of bread. On a normal day everything sells out quick so it's best to come early.
any: Come early. Everything's gone by ten and I don't bake twice.
Bread wants patience and a hot oven. People want it now. We compromise.
You smell like the farm. That's a compliment.
sabine.gift_love: %item! Oh, I know exactly what this becomes. Come by tomorrow.

intro: You're a farmer? My job is to make sure the town stays lit at night and any unwanted animals have a home. Good, honest, hands-on work - just like farming.
any: I'll be lighting the lamps at dusk. Watch your step until then.
The pen's got a goat with opinions this week.
Everyone needs somewhere to go at night. People, animals, same thing.

intro: Symptoms, duration, anything you've already taken. In that order.#$b#...Oh. You're not ill. Then what are you doing way out in the forest?
any: Don't touch that. Actually, touch it and tell me what happens.
Most 'magic' is just a plant nobody bothered to name.
If it's bleeding, apply pressure. If it isn't, why are you here?

intro: You didn't jump! Most people jump. Jumping's fair, I get it, but it's nice when someone new doesn't.
any: Do you ever feel like you're walking through someone?
The graveyard's quiet. I'd know.
I don't remember my name. The town gave me this one. I like it fine.

intro: Hello I am Derrick. That is short for my full designation DERRICK-32. I prefer just Derrick.
any: I apologize for the noise earlier. Hydraulics.
Derrick is a crane. Derrick is also me. Both lift things.
Today's task list: lift, carry, wait, repeat. It is a good list.

intro: I love how quiet this town is. Please don't change that.
any: Shh. Not for you. For the books. They startle.
There is a chair by the window that no one uses. It's yours if you're quiet.
Overdue books are a personal failing.

intro: Ah! The new player character has arrived.#$b#Don't worry, I know how these stories go.#$b#You're probably looking for your first quest.
any: The music feels unusually peaceful today.
I'm saving this. You never know when a fetch quest will appear.
Someone around here definitely has dialogue that changes after sunset.
You should talk to everyone twice.
Always check behind waterfalls.
I'd wave, but I'm waiting for my idle animation.
You can't fool me. That suspicious-looking wall is hiding something.
The developers love hiding treasure in barrels.
Every village has one oddly important chicken.
I think I just completed a side quest.
rain: Rain usually means better fishing loot.
Weather systems always increase rare spawn rates.
moving_in: I've been waiting for the opening cutscene.
You're probably looking for your first quest.

intro: You're the new variable. Amora. I do rocks, mostly. Don't say 'geology' like it's a hobby.
any: The effect is trending toward significance, but n is small.
This one's a chert. That one's also a chert. They're different cherts.
I don't 'like' things. I record them. Recording is going well.

Every heart event I've ever had, there was a cat in it. Uninvited.

Wood or yarn? Don't answer, I've already started both.
